title: Part editor
readOnly: Editing a part needs a wider screen. You can read it here.
copyNote: This part ships with iynk. Saving makes your own copy as {id}.
notFound: That part is not in the library, so this is a new one.

identity.name: Name
identity.nameHint: Shown in the library and on the canvas.

pins.heading: Pins
pins.empty: No pins yet. Add the first one.
pins.removeBody: Pin {id} leaves the part, along with every group and rating that names it.
pins.added: Pin added. The part has {count} pins.
pins.removed: Pin {id} removed. The part has {count} pins.
pins.cascade: Also changed because of the pin: {where}

groups.heading: Groups
groups.hint: Pins in a group are joined inside the part.

footprint.heading: Size and drawing
footprint.label: Label on the drawing
footprint.outside: These pins fall outside the drawn body: {pins}

art.heading: Picture
art.hint: An SVG or a PNG. Without one, the part is drawn from the size and pins above.

error.not-xml: The file is not valid SVG.
error.doctype: The SVG has a document type declaration, which is not allowed.
error.entity: The SVG defines entities, which is not allowed.
error.cdata: The SVG has a CDATA section, which is not allowed.
error.processing-instruction: The SVG has a processing instruction, which is not allowed.
error.depth: The SVG is nested too deeply.
error.too-many-elements: The SVG has too many elements.
error.root-not-svg: The file does not start with an svg element.
error.png-signature: The file is not a PNG.
error.png-too-large: The PNG is larger than 2048 by 2048 pixels.
error.png-truncated: The PNG file is cut short.

json.label: Part descriptor as JSON
json.hint: Changes here replace the form when you leave this tab. Fix a parse error first.

save.conflict: A different part with this id and version is already saved. Stored: {installed}. Yours: {incoming}. Change the version or the id and save again.
save.full: Storage is full. Free some space and save again.
save.failed: The part was not saved. Try again.

discard.title: Leave without saving?
discard.body: Your changes to this part are kept as a draft in this browser until you start over.

ratings.heading: Ratings
ratings.hint: Limits and typical values. Each can come from the maker, from your own assumption or from a bench measurement. The simulation reads one of them.
ratings.empty: No ratings yet. Choosing a model writes the ones it needs, and you can add more.
ratings.measuredNote: Bench measurements are added in the JSON view.
ratings.needSource: Choose where the number for {key} comes from.

sources.heading: Sources
sources.hint: Where your numbers come from. A number from a maker's datasheet needs one of these.
sources.title: Title of {id}

model.heading: Model
model.hint: Pick how the part behaves. A model here is a teaching model, a starting point you can refine in the JSON view.
model.sequentialNote: A truth table has no memory, so flip-flops and counters are not offered here.
model.replaces: This replaces the layer, test and ratings the previous model wrote. Ratings you added yourself stay.

problems.pins: This model needs at least {need} pins. Add them in the Pins tab.

empty.inputs: Pick at least one input pin.
empty.outputs: Pick at least one output pin.

tooMany.inputs: A table takes at most {max} inputs.
tooMany.outputs: A table takes at most {max} outputs.
tooMany.rows: A table takes at most {max} rows.

problems.overlap: A pin cannot be both an input and an output.
problems.order: The lowest value must be below the highest.
problems.reason: Say why it is not modelled.

table.caption: Truth table rows, the first matching row wins
table.limit: A table holds at most {max} rows.
table.noColumns: Pick the input and output pins first.
table.shadowed: Row {n} is never reached: an earlier row covers it.
table.added: Row added. The table has {count} rows.
table.removed: Row {n} removed. The table has {count} rows.
table.completed: Added {count} rows for the missing input combinations.

palette.notSaved: Parts will not be saved in this browser mode.
palette.importFailed: The pack could not be added. Nothing was changed.
palette.conflict: A different part with the same id and version is already saved. Nothing was changed.
palette.readFailed: That file could not be read.
